name: max_pool3d_with_indices
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::max_pool3d_with_indices(Tensor self, int[3] kernel_size, int[3] stride=[], int[3] padding=0, int[3] dilation=1, bool ceil_mode=False) -> (Tensor output, Tensor indices). Applies three-dimensional max pooling and returns both values and flattened int64 spatial indices without mutating or aliasing self. Coverage includes cubic and non-cubic parameters, default stride, padding, dilation, ceil mode, noncontiguous input, output metadata, explicit storage non-aliasing, input-gradient comparison, invalid rank and invalid parameters.
